social_post.caption:
💪 Squat form check: are you making this mistake?

We see it all the time - knees caving inward during squats. This puts unnecessary stress on your joints and limits your strength gains.

The fix:
✅ Push knees out in line with toes
✅ Engage your glutes throughout the movement
✅ Keep core tight
✅ Control the descent

Results? Safer squats, stronger legs, better gains.

Our trainers are here to help perfect your form. Drop in for a free assessment this week!

👉 Link in bio to schedule

#WorkoutTips #SquatForm #StrengthTraining #GymLife #FitnessEducation #ProperForm

email.subject: Let's Talk About Your Fitness Goals, Sarah
email.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for reaching out about membership at IronWorks Fitness!

I saw that you're interested in strength training and group classes. Great combo! Our members who focus on both tend to see amazing results and really enjoy the community aspect.

Here's what we offer that fits your goals:

🏋️ Full strength training area with Olympic platforms, racks, and free weights
💪 20+ weekly group classes including HIIT, strength circuits, and yoga
🎯 Complimentary fitness assessment and program design
👥 Supportive community (we're big on celebrating everyone's wins!)

Membership Options:
- Unlimited: $89/month (no contract)
- 12-month commitment: $69/month
- Both include all classes and open gym

Special: This week only - waived enrollment fee ($99 value) + free week trial

When can you come in for a tour? I'm here tomorrow at 10am and 5pm, or we can schedule another time that works for you.

Looking forward to meeting you!

Mike
Membership Director
IronWorks Fitness
📞 (843) 555-0199
🔗 Schedule tour: [link]
